$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for cross-cutting conventions. Hand-edit THIS file, then run `pnpm gen` to regenerate every derived artifact (manifest.json, .github/CODEOWNERS, gate-budget.json, eslint FEATURE_ROOTS). `pnpm gen:check` (part of `pnpm verify`) fails if any generated file is stale. Adding a feature root / gate / owned path here — and ONLY here — is how those propagate without drift. Modeled on fitapp/conventions.json.

featureRoots.$comment: The mobile feature-domain roots (see docs/02-engineering-requirements.md §2). Each gets an eslint import/no-restricted-paths zone forbidding cross-feature imports. MUST match the directories under packages/mobile/features/. Adding a domain here is the ONLY place to declare it.

humanOwnedPaths.$comment: Paths requiring the human principal's approval. Generated into .github/CODEOWNERS. The agent token does NOT have write access here — this is the agent's own cage, so it must not be self-editable. PARKED until a remote + branch protection exist, but CODEOWNERS is generated so it's correct when activated.

paths.why: Single source of truth — drift here propagates everywhere
Pre-commit gate wiring — must not be self-editable
Agent's own runtime cage — must not be self-editable
Agent runtime guards — must not be self-editable
Migration approval tokens — human-only destructive-DDL approvals

gateBudget.$comment: Gate budget registry (agent-arch Rule 5). Sum of SYNCHRONOUS (async:false, commit-blocking) weights must be <= maxBudget. Weights: structural=0, mechanical=1, advisory=2. async=true gates run post-merge and do NOT count. This is the SCAFFOLD baseline: only gates whose target code exists yet are wired synchronously. DB-backed gates (check-rls, check-migration-drift) and code-shape gates (check-route-schema, check-unbounded-select) are declared here as they land with their subsystems — add them to this list AND scripts/verify.mjs in the same task that adds the code they guard, naming what each replaces.
